results.jcoql:
GET COLLECTION orders;
FILTER CASE WHERE .orderDate IN_RANGE [ -30 , 0 ] KEEP OTHERS;

GET COLLECTION customers;
FILTER CASE WHERE .orders >= 3 KEEP OTHERS;

GET COLLECTION products;
FILTER CASE WHERE .discount > 0.20 GENERATE ADD FIELDS { .stato_sconto : 'attivo' } KEEP OTHERS;

GET COLLECTION users;
FILTER CASE WHERE .registration_date IN_RANGE [ 20240101 , 20240131 ] KEEP OTHERS;

GET COLLECTION books;
FILTER CASE WHERE .year > 2020 KEEP OTHERS;
